summary: Iter144 Team Hub calendar (Single-Day Time Tweak + Cancelled Badge + Import Date Range) tested end-to-end on preview. BACKEND 7/7 pytest tests pass against /app/backend/tests/test_iter144_overrides_and_cancel_badge.py. A weekly Monday QA144 Practice (2026-11-02 → 2026-12-10 at 18:00-20:00) expands to 6 occurrences all with has_override=false, cancelled=false. POST /override-occurrence {occ_date:'2026-11-16', start_time:'17:00', end_time:'19:00', notes:'Early start'} flips ONLY that row to 17:00/19:00/'Early start' with has_override=true; the other 5 remain at 18:00/20:00 with has_override=false. POST /clear-override reverts that date to 18:00/20:00 and has_override=false. POST /cancel-occurrence on a different date (2026-11-23) keeps it in the list with cancelled:true (iter144 change: previously removed). Validation: override-occurrence with empty occ_date → 400; override-occurrence with no editable fields → 400; override-occurrence on unknown event id → 404. All QA144 events cleaned up (final list contains 0 QA144*). FRONTEND verified via mobile-viewport Playwright (390x844) on /team/calendar as demo@cheerplanner.app: (a) Single-day tweak — tapping a recurring row opens detail with testID event-edit-occurrence; tapping it opens testID occurrence-edit-modal (5 inputs — title, 2 time pickers, location, notes); testID occ-save-btn persists. Reopening the same date now shows testID event-reset-override and the row renders an override edit-icon badge (verified visually). (b) Cancelled badge — a cancelled Mon Nov 23 row remains in the List view as a dimmed, strike-through card with a yellow 'Cancelled' pill; opening it reveals testID event-restore-occurrence for staff. (c) Import Date Range — the Import to TeamHub modal (testID import-personal-modal) now exposes testID imp-date-range with testID imp-from-date and imp-to-date pickers; setting a narrow Nov 2–Nov 9 range filtered the list from 3 rows to 0 rows ('No items in this date range. Widen the range above.'), and testID imp-range-clear restored the full list back to 3 rows. No deprecated expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch usage; no SafeAreaView issues in team_calendar.py / calendar.tsx. Both features from iter144 are fully working on web + backend. Known reminder from iter143: the two remaining Alert.alert() multi-button confirms ('Save changes to all dates' and 'Cancel just this date') still rely on native rendering — unchanged in iter144 and not needed for the three features under test here.
action_items: None required for iter144. Features implemented correctly on backend and web preview UI.

app/team/calendar.tsx is now 989 lines (↑ from 838 last iter) — well above the 700-line soft threshold. OccurrenceForm, EventForm, DetailModal and ImportFromPersonalModal should be split into separate files next time the screen needs changes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all iter144 testIDs render and behave as specified (single-day override + reset, cancelled card + restore, import date-range filter + clear)

The team calendar needs testID teamcal-view-list to switch to List mode (Month is the default). testIDs confirmed on 2026-10-02: calendar-screen, teamcal-view-list, calendar-import-personal, event-<id>-<occ>, event-edit-occurrence, event-reset-override, event-restore-occurrence, event-cancel-occurrence, occurrence-edit-modal, occ-save-btn, import-personal-modal, imp-date-range, imp-from-date, imp-to-date, imp-range-clear, import-personal-confirm. Date inputs inside DateField render a nested <input> that accepts fill('YYYY-MM-DD').
